name: GEF Small Grants Programme Indonesia
summary: Indonesia's SGP country programme, hosted by the NGO Yayasan Bina Usaha Lingkungan, gives planning grants and full grants to NGOs and local communities for forest, coastal, marine and agrobiodiversity work.

calls.label: Call for proposals: youth movements for environmental issues

status.quote: Proposals must be submitted by June 3, 2024

deadline.quote: Proposals must be submitted by June 3, 2024

administered_by.quote: Since 1997 the GEF SGP has been operating on a permanent basis by hosting an environment-based NGO called Yayasan Bina Usaha Lingkungan.

applicant_types.quote: GEF SGP Indonesia is part of natural resource management communities and supports at least 200 Non-Governmental Organizations and Local Communities that fulfill the criteria.

access.quote: The GEF-SGP Indonesia Secretariat invites you to the Call for Proposals for the Youth Movement for Environmental Issues.

window.quote: Proposals must be submitted by June 3, 2024

amount.quote: Each partner will receive US$ 2,000-5,000 for a Planning Grant with a project duration of 3 - 6 Months or up to US$ 10,000-50,000 for a full grant with a project duration of 12 - 24 months.
